objects: one complete-card-admitted physical card with fixed ordinary-mana Foretell
costs: the later cast may use the fixed printed Foretell alternative cost
timing: the special action requires priority during the owner's turn
the card may be cast only after that turn ends and otherwise follows ordinary timing
targets: targets are chosen only for the later cast
choices: both staging and later casting are optional
hidden_information: only the owner sees the face-down exile identity while each viewer sees one distinguishable face-down object
layers: current ability applicability gates only the hand special action; the designation persists without the ability
replacement_effects: the hand-to-exile move uses the canonical zone replacement owner
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and repeated Foretell forms remain unsupported
control_change: the exile card has no controller and remains owned by its physical owner
zone_change: leaving exile ends the designation; a returned incarnation is not foretold
source_leaves: the stored logical identity prevents a new exile incarnation from inheriting the old permission
